name: Drake
description: Flightless and lowly among dragons, these volcanic dwellers are hunted by aspiring dragoons as a rite of passage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, drakes can make an attack (d20+17) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 4 square cone. If successful, targets take 4d6+7 fire damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. The drake may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

name: Hydra
description: A savage dragon with multiple vicious heads, each as deadly as the last.

abilities.name: Dual Mind
abilities.description: Hydras add twice their level to their Will Defence.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a hydra loses a limb, they can grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

abilities.name: Triad
abilities.description: When the hydra attacks a single creature with its bite, it combos on a natural 19-20.

abilities.name: Tribite
abilities.description: When the hydra uses a primary action to attack with its bite, it may attack up to 3 targets, making a separate attack roll for each target.

steal: Coral Sword (5%), Dragon Scale (20%), Storm Crystal (95%) Dragons The mighty children of Fomalhaut, they once held the world by the throat, ruling through sheer terror. While they are a far cry from what they once were, they are still fiercely powerful and formidable creatures. Dragons progress as beasts, however, they gain 2 attribute increases at every 4th level, as normal, and gain an amount of MP equal to 3+Mnd at each level.

name: Wyvern
languages: Draconic Iconic dragons of Val’daera’s skies, often used in heraldry to symbolize majesty.
description: Iconic dragons of Val’daera’s skies, often used in heraldry to symbolize majesty.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, wyverns can make an attack (d20+19) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, targets take 6d6+9 fire damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. A wyvern may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Tail Slam
abilities.description: Whenever the wyvern uses a primary action to attack while flanked, it may make a free slam attack (d20+21) against another target within its reach that is providing the initial target the flanking bonus. This attack deals 1d6+11 damage.

loot: Dragon Heart (5%), Dragon Bone (20%), Dragon Scale (50%)

name: Balaur
description: Fierce ice dragons that terrorize the northern highlands, often moving south in pursuit of fleeing prey.

abilities.name: Dual Mind
abilities.description: Balaur add twice their level to their Will Defence.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.description: When a balaur loses a limb, they can grow it back in 1d10+1 days, at which point any penalties are removed.

abilities.name: Triumvirate
abilities.description: When the balaur attacks a single creature with its bite attack, it combos on the result of 18-20.

abilities.name: Tribite
abilities.description: When the balaur uses a primary action to attack with its bite, it may target up to 3 targets, making a separate attack roll for each target.

loot: Dragon Heart (5%), Dragon Scale (20%), Dragon Bone (50%)

name: Wyrm
languages: Draconic Dreaded dragons of the Badlands, awakening from long slumbers to lay waste to cities in hunger.
description: Dreaded dragons of the Badlands, awakening from long slumbers to lay waste to cities in hunger.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Whenever a wyrm reduces a creature to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge with its bite attack, the creature is immediately swallowed, killed (regardless of hero points), and removed from play. The wyrm then immediately heals an amount of HP equal to the swallowed creature’s (level + Vit modifier) x2. Additionally, as a primary action, the wyrm may perform a coup de grace on an unconscious creature, devouring the creature.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, a wyrm can make an attack (d20+23) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 12 square cone. If successful, targets take 8d6+13 fire damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. The wyrm may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Tail Slam
abilities.description: Whenever the wyrm uses a primary action to attack while flanked, it may make a free slam attack (d20+28) against another target within reach that is providing the initial target the flanking bonus. This attack deals 1d8+18 damage.

loot: Stardust (5%), Dragon Heart (20%), Dragon Scale (50%), Dragon Bone (95%)

name: Zilant
languages: Draconic Majestic and regal, these azure dragons are prized above all by the dragoneers of Akarta.
description: Majestic and regal, these azure dragons are prized above all by the dragoneers of Akarta.

abilities.name: Forked Lightning
abilities.description: As a primary action, the zilant can make an attack (d20+25) against the Ref Defence of up to 6 creatures within a 12 square cone. If successful, targets take 10d6+15 electric damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beat both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes paralysed. The zilant may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Tail Slam
abilities.description: Whenever the zilant uses a primary action to attack while flanked, it may make a free slam attack (d20+28) against another target within reach that is providing the initial target the flanking bonus. This attack deals 1d8+18 damage.

loot: Bolt Pendant (5%), Dragon Heart (20%), Dragon Scale (50%), Dragon Bone (95%)

name: Lindwyrm
languages: Draconic Ancient dragons of the Jorunheim Tundra, where their immense hunger is matched only by the land’s savage bounty.
description: Ancient dragons of the Jorunheim Tundra, where their immense hunger is matched only by the land’s savage bounty.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Whenever a lindwyrm reduces a creature to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge with its bite attack, the creature is immediately swallowed, killed (regardless of hero points), and removed from play. The lindwyrm then immediately heals an amount of HP equal to the swallowed creature’s (level + Vit modifier) x2. Additionally, as a primary action, the lindwyrm may perform a coup de grace on an unconscious creature, devouring the creature.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Any enemy that begins its turn within the lindwyrm’s reach is subject to an attack roll (d20+23) against their Will Defence. If successful, the target becomes flat-footed and may take no actions until the start of its next turn. However, any creature that resisted this effect cannot be targeted by this ability again, for the duration of the encounter. This is a fear effect.

abilities.name: Ice Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, lindwyrms can make an attack (d20+29) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 12 square cone. If successful, targets take 10d6+19 cold damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beats both a target’s Ref and Fort Defence, their speed is reduced to 2 squares until the start of the lindwyrm's next turn. A lindwyrm may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Tail Slam
abilities.description: Whenever the lindwyrm uses a primary action to attack while flanked, it may make a free slam attack (d20+34) against another target within reach that is providing the initial target the flanking bonus. This attack deals 2d6+24 damage.

loot: Dragon Heart (20%), Dragon Scale (50%), Dragon Bone (95%)

name: Turtle, Dragon
languages: Draconic Vast and ancient, their shells are often mistaken for sea stacks or islands—until the “land” begins to move. Pity those who anchor too close.
description: Vast and ancient, their shells are often mistaken for sea stacks or islands—until the “land” begins to move. Pity those who anchor too close.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Whenever a dragon turtle reduces a creature to 0 HP or the bottom of the Break Gauge with its bite attack, the creature is immediately swallowed, killed (regardless of hero points), and removed from play. The dragon turtle then immediately heals an amount of HP equal to the swallowed creature’s (level + Vit modifier) x2. Additionally, as a primary action, the dragon turtle may perform a coup de grace on an unconscious creature, devouring the creature.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, the dragon turtle can make an attack (d20+27) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 12 square cone. If successful, targets take 10d6+17 fire damage. Otherwise, targets take half damage. The dragon turtle may not use this ability again for 1d4 +1 turns. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: The dragon turtle cannot be moved by any means of forced movement, including teleportation.

abilities.name: Impassable*
abilities.description: Creatures may not move through squares occupied by the dragon turtle, regardless of size.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.description: When in marine, freshwater, or beach environments, dragon turtles treat Stealth as a trained skill and ignore any size penalties to Stealth checks when in water.

abilities.name: Mighty Guard
abilities.description: As a secondary action, the dragon turtle can retreat into its shell for 1d4+1 turns. While in its shell, the dragon turtle clears itself of all status effects (except curses) and gains immunity to all status effects (except curses). Additionally, if damaged by melee attacks, half the damage the dragon turtle would suffer is instead dealt to the attacker as unaspected damage. Once this effect ends, the dragon turtle may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

loot: Stardust (5%), Adamantite (20%), Dragon Heart (50%), Dragon Bone (95%)
